context: A student nervous about voicing her dreams
purpose: Encourage self-expression; teach 語る/挙げ/現れ/間違っ/許さ/それとも

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、夢を語るのって恥ずかしいです。
lines.en: Teacher, speaking about my dream is embarrassing.
lines.style: shy teen confessing her hesitation, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 語る勇気が成長につながりますよ。
lines.en: The courage to speak leads to growth.
lines.style: gentle teacher offering reassurance, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 例を挙げると、将来は医者になりたいです。
lines.en: To give an example, I want to be a doctor.
lines.style: brave teen taking a first step

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いい例を挙げましたね。
lines.style: warmly affirming teacher praising her, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でも自信が現れたり消えたりします。
lines.en: But my confidence appears and disappears.
lines.style: wavering teen describing her doubts, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 迷いが現れるのは自然なことです。
lines.en: It is natural for hesitation to appear.
lines.style: understanding teacher normalizing doubt, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 選択を間違ったらどうしよう。
lines.en: What if I make the wrong choice?
lines.style: anxious teen fearing a mistake, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 間違っても、やり直せます。自分を許さないのが一番怖い。
lines.en: Even if you err, you can redo it. Not forgiving yourself is scariest.
lines.style: wise teacher offering deep reassurance, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 医者、それとも研究者、まだ迷ってます。
lines.en: A doctor, or a researcher, I am still unsure.
lines.style: honest teen weighing her options, tone holding steady through the whole line
